protected_cells: P4 — the regression bound applies to every cell; there is no separate protected subset

pairing.order: alternating A/B, predeclared A-first fixed order (A,B,A,B,A,B), fresh process per run
pairing.aggregate: per-cell paired ratios + geomean of per-cell paired-median ratios across P1-P4 (both wall and a startup-separated view)
pairing.timer: time.perf_counter around the entry call in a fresh subprocess; interpreter/import time OUTSIDE the timer (warm-entry claim); cold-entry overhead measured separately in a dedicated cold leg

candidate_side_route_coverage: prepared GVF primary on every daytime step (P1/P3: 14/24 each; P2 has no gvf demand surface on this fixture — recorded as observed)
Lcyl_v2022a + define_patch_characteristics primaries on every step (24/24 incl. night)
aniLum packed primary on daytime steps
Lside: 24 demanded calls per run all taking an exact non-body route (upstream fast + dispatch twin), reference 0
eligible_work_definition.gate: >=80% of the PREDECLARED eligible calls admitted on the candidate (P1-P3, in-process counters), plus 0 reference fallbacks on production profiles; A-side route counters do not exist on main (patch_radiation.ROUTE_COUNTS absent at b3e5ca59 — verified) and are disclosed as such
eligible_work_definition.whole_workload_coverage: route counters are diagnostics, not the timing population; walls cover the full entry regardless

gates.masks: requested cpu_budget/memory and actual masks recorded per run (options echo + runtime admission outputs); no hidden workload reduction
gates.cold_first_use: one cold leg per side (empty numba/function caches where the product controls them; OS page cache NOT controlled — disclosed): cold wall recorded separately, not folded into the warm geomean
gates.interpretation: BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL claim hierarchy: paired ratios on a contended host are directional; the qualify/retain decision uses predeclared gates with noise disclosed, never a single quiet rep

diagnostics_not_gates: L2 quiet-window Lside rerun (S10-23/S10-30 commitment): s10_lside_l2.py l2run pairs repeated when loadavg < 8, recorded separately
startup-residual decomposition (S10-22 ride-along): s10_residual_profile.py executed against BOTH sides once, attributing the 18.7%-of-tile startup bucket; attribution only, no speedup claim
per-run RSS/PSS of the worker tree where available (runtime reports admitted workers + PIDs; sampled peaks recorded if cheaply available)
required_fields_per_trial: outputs_sha256 or bitwise verdict vs recorded run
raw_trials_path: evidence/trials/raw_trials.jsonl (one record per run) + raw dir payloads archived to Dropbox
decision_rule: Predeclared per DECISION_AND_MERGE.md: all gates pass -> qualified_exact_cpu track (with S10-31 DX checks); protected regression >3% or coverage <80% -> retain/reject per the predeclared non-regression policy; inconclusive noise -> rerun within causal_large_retry_max or call it inconclusive, never 'passed'
